summary: Round 1. The generic arms all end on the start's traps (control / speed-equiv slide into kill sheet *18 at 5.7-5.9; per-call energy and the death charge camp on the platform). Go-Explore never leaves the pit, but its archive holds the record's post-pit corridor (a trough under the platform) reached via the platform's SW corner. A backward curriculum on that 10 s GE line (tc, from scratch) took the greedy line to 7.43 at 101M; resumed with per-call energy shaping K8 (tce) 7.70 at 703M. The gate now: a floor landing costs ~600 E and the trough exit is too slow to clear *18's west edge; running tce2 (K16, no success bonus) + GE6 rooted in the trough to find a pump.
